changelog.title: What's New
items: ♻️ refactor(widgets,updater): rename Echo-named widget manager and notification provider
✨ feat(player): add varispeed, linking pitch to playback speed
✨ feat(extensions): add addon enable switch and https:// for addon URLs without a scheme
• style(artist): make the Subscribe button a standalone pill
✨ feat(lyrics): use the metadata cleaner for lyrics search queries
✨ feat(playback): add dynamic LRU cache evictor that keeps track openings
✨ feat(widgets): add Modern, Slim, Square, Showcase, Vintage, Vinyl and Adaptive widgets
✨ feat(audio): add spatial audio stereo widener to the playback chain
✨ feat(usb): add USB DAC bit-perfect output with JNI driver
✨ feat(metadata): add title and artist cleaner as its own module
✨ feat(generate): add Generate taste mix from listening history
✨ feat(content): block artists and hide their content

changelog.title: Fixes
items: 🔧 feat(player,ui): playback recovery fix, varispeed, addon toggle, subscribe pill, carousel, share
🔧 fix(share): wait for the player connection before playing a shared link
🔧 fix(sync): skip commits already in Cineflix and cap AI time per run
🔧 fix(di): bind GenerationStatus to RealGenerationStatus
🔧 fix(kotlin): resolve compile errors from the Echo port
🔧 fix(res): complete widget colors, strings and style references
🔧 fix(res): add all widget colors used by the widget drawables and layouts
🔧 fix(res): add widget colors used by the widget drawables
🔧 fix(res): remove duplicate spatial audio strings
